Chapter 402 - 402 Wake Up; A Fan!

Chapter 402 - 402 Wake Up; A Fan!

402 Wake Up; A Fan!

Creak!

With a soft sound, the door of the ward was firmly closed.

However…

Everyone in the hall was still staring at the door, as if they could see the situation in the ward through the door.

…

This ward was about 100 square meters and was extremely spacious.

The air was filled with the smell of medicine.

On the soft bed lay a thin, sallow-faced old man.

Obviously, he was Tang Mingyuan.

Tang Mingyuan was wearing an oxygen mask over his nose. The electrocardiogram beside him was slowly fluctuating.

Everything showed that Tang Mingyuan’s situation was very bad.

Lin Fan observed silently for a while. Then, he placed his finger on Tang Ming Yuan’s skinny wrist.

After about a minute, Lin Fan retracted his finger.

“With normal treatment, it’ll take at least two months to get better.”

One had to know that Lin Fan had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience.

Even so, it would take two months to get better. It was not an exaggeration to say that Tang Mingyuan was terminally ill.

Lin Fan said, “That’s too troublesome. I’ll just use Medical Water.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan spent ten million yuan to buy a bottle of Medical Water from the system.

Then, he took off Tang Mingyuan’s oxygen mask and poured the Medical Water into his mouth.

After drinking the Medical Water…

The weak fluctuations in the electrocardiography began to rise.

Following that, a tinge of blood appeared on Tang Mingyuan’s sallow face.

Then, his motionless body twitched slightly.

Finally, Tang Mingyuan slowly opened his slightly turbid eyes.

He first looked at the ceiling.

Then, his gaze landed on Lin Fan.

“And you are?” Tang Mingyuan asked in a hoarse voice.

“My name is Lin Fan. Old Master Zhou asked me to save you,” Lin Fan said.

“Old Zhou is really thoughtful. Thank you for saving me,” Tang Mingyuan said in realization.

“You’re welcome. The people outside should be waiting anxiously. I’ll let them in first,” Lin Fan said.

As soon as he finished speaking, he turned around and opened the door.

Creak!

When everyone saw the door open, they could not help but look into the ward.

“How’s Old Tang?” Zhou Guotao asked.

Lin Fan said, “He’s fine. He’s already awake. You can go in and see him.”

He was fine?

He was already awake?

In fact, ever since Lin Fan entered the ward… it had only taken a few minutes.

In just a few minutes, he cured a seriously ill person?

How was this possible?

Many of the people present had doubtful looks on their faces.

Then, they slowly walked inside.

When they saw Tang Mingyuan lying on the bed, they realized that his complexion had improved and he had already woken up. They all became extremely excited.

He was awake!

He really woke up!

“Old Master, it’s great that you’re awake!”

“That’s great!”

“Old Master…”

…

Tang Hua hurriedly stepped forward and asked, “Dad, do you feel uncomfortable anywhere?”

Tang Mingyuan shook his head.

His thoughts were clear, and his voice was steady and powerful!

“Quick, check my dad’s physical condition,” Tang Kai said to the doctors beside him.

The three doctors responded and went forward to listen to the old master’s voice, take his pulse, look at his pupils, and check his tongue…

Soon, their eyes widened in disbelief.

“How’s Old Master?” Tang Kai asked anxiously. “Hurry up and say something!”

The bald doctor finally reacted and stuttered, “His condition is very good! However… It’s best to do a more detailed examination…”

With the doctor’s confirmation, the Tang family became even happier.

At the same time, everyone looked at Lin Fan in shock.

“Old Zhou, you even rushed all the way from Jingbei for me, an old bag of bones. I really feel bad.”

“Why are you still so polite between us?” Zhou Guotao asked.

“Yes, yes, yes.” Tang Mingyuan nodded.

Everyone did not stay in the ward for long.

Firstly, the doctors still needed to do a further examination on Tang Mingyuan.

Secondly, Tang Mingyuan had just woken up and needed to rest.

It was nighttime…

Lin Fan, Ling Rou, Zhou Guotao, and the others stayed in Hilltop Villa under the invitation of the Tang family.

Unlike the Peninsula Hotel, which was located in the middle of the city and was extremely noisy, Hilltop Villa was located on a quiet mountaintop. When one looked up, they could see the bright stars. It was a different feeling.

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

When Lin Fan and Ling Rou went downstairs, Tang Mingyuan and Zhou Guotao were sitting in the courtyard, chatting about interesting things and laughing from time to time.

When Tang Mingyuan saw Lin Fan, he asked with concern, “Did you sleep alright?”

Lin Fan said, “The air is fresh, and the scenery is great. It’s very comfortable. Old Master is good at choosing locations.”

“Is that so? Since you like it, there’s another similar house on the opposite mountain. I’ll give it to you,” Tang Mingyuan said.

A villa on the top of a mountain!

One had to know that the price of Hilltop Villa was several billion yuan!

In fact, there was no supply!

This was not something that could be bought with money.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “Forget it. I rarely come to Hong Kong.”

“You rarely come, but you will come! It’s better than leaving it empty in my hands,” Tang Mingyuan said.

Zhou Guotao smiled and said, “Lin Fan, just accept it. It’s just a villa. It’s nothing to you and Old Tang.”

When Lin Fan heard that, he did not reject it anymore.

It was because he had slept very comfortably yesterday.

Also, Ling Rou seemed to like this place.

“Alright, then I’ll accept your offer,” Lin Fan said.

Instantly, the atmosphere became more relaxed.

Tang Hua walked over slowly with a graceful, dignified, and beautiful woman on his arm.

Tang Mingyuan said, “Tang Hua, you came at the right time. Quickly transfer Villa 6 to Lin Fan.”

“Alright,” Tang Hua said.

Although Villa 6 was quite valuable, compared to Tang Mingyuan’s life, it was not worth mentioning at all.

Tang Mingyuan’s medical report was out.

His body had completely recovered.

In fact, his body stats were even better than before his illness!

It was all because of Lin Fan!

Therefore, Tang Hua did not hesitate.

“Are you Sister Ni Min?” Ling Rou, who had been standing at the side, suddenly shouted in surprise.

The dignified and beautiful woman smiled and said, “It’s me.”

“It’s really you, Sister Ni Min! I’m a fan of yours!” Ling Rou exclaimed excitedly. “Out of all your albums, I like Spring and Four Seasons the most!”

This sentence definitely came from Ling Rou’s heart.

In fact, a large part of the reason why she stayed in the bar and wanted to become a singer was because of Ni Min’s influence.

She yearned to be like Ni Min, to sing wantonly at a grand concert and receive the applause of countless people.

Later, Ni Min suddenly quit the entertainment industry. There were rumors that she married into a wealthy family.

From the looks of it, she had married into the Tang family.
